summary.en: The plakat look: warm paper, one ink for text, rules and solid blocks, one accent for the person and the person's decisions, a visible 12-column grid, giant numerals beside small mono labels; Inter Tight and IBM Plex Mono.
summary.zh: plakat 的样式：暖白纸、一种墨色管文字、细线和实块，唯一的强调色只给“人和人的决定”，12 栏网格露在画面上，巨型数字配小号等宽标签；字体 Inter Tight 与 IBM Plex Mono。

fits: Products whose story is a clear claim plus a sequence of steps or decisions with a person at the start and the end: developer workflows, review and approval tools, rollout tools.
notFor: Products that need space, depth or spectacle; numbers about many items; stories with no human decision for the accent to mark.

intent.en: A product launch set like a Swiss concert-poster series: restraint and a visible system make every step read as decided, and the one colour shows where a person decides.
intent.zh: 把产品发布排成一套瑞士音乐会海报：克制和看得见的体系让每一步都显得经过斟酌，唯一的颜色指出人在哪里做决定。

content.en: A claim, three to six steps or decisions, real technical material for at least one page (commands, ids, numbers), a product name and URL.
content.zh: 一句主张、三到六个步骤或决定、至少一页真实技术物料（命令、编号、数字）、产品名与网址。

fits.zh: 故事是“清楚的主张 + 一串步骤或决定”、首尾有人的产品：开发流程、审核与审批工具、发布工具。

notFor.zh: 需要空间、纵深或大场面的产品；关于大量条目的数字；没有人的决定可让强调色标记的故事。

en: The accent is for blocks and large type only in signal, orange, clay and poster-coral (about 3:1 on paper).
Chinese has no capitals and no negative tracking; labels are 28 px and body 40 px, so a Chinese page holds fewer items.
zh: signal、orange、clay、poster-coral 的强调色在纸上约 3:1，只能用于色块和大字。
中文不转大写、不加负字距；标签 28 px、正文 40 px，中文页放得下的条目更少。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
